q: The following one is not relevant to the "Proficiency in Hindi" as per Official Language Rules, 1976

options.A: An employee have passed matriculation examination or any equivalent or higher examination through Hindi;
options.B: An employee Have taken Hindi as an elective subject in the Graduate Examination or any other examination equivalent to or higher than the Graduate Examination;
